summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd., a Cayman Islands-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-8 reverse stock split of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, approved by shareholders and the board on July 13, 2026. As of the filing, the company had 18,764,216 ordinary shares outstanding, including 10,000,000 Class A shares issued in a private placement closed August 3, 2026, and 2,400,000 Class A shares under the 2026 Share Incentive Plan. Post-split, shares will reduce to 2,345,527, with fractional shares rounded up. The split is expected effective August 6, 2026, with trading under the same ticker BYAH but a new CUSIP G6925R128. Authorized share capital was adjusted accordingly, and no other material terms change. The split likely aims to regain Nasdaq listing compliance. What to watch: any Nasdaq notice and potential trading volatility around the effective date.
